claims.text: The target component is made from a hot-cracking-sensitive alloy with microstructural characteristics that make conventional fusion-welding repair unsuitable.
Cold spray deposition followed by controlled low-temperature annealing will produce a dense, mechanically bonded repair overlay.
The cold-sprayed and annealed overlay will have a refined microstructure with minimal oxide inclusions.
Post-deposition annealing will enhance interparticle bonding and recover ductility.
Particle velocities greater than 500 m/s provide sufficient kinetic energy for mechanical bonding to the substrate.
Annealing at 500–700 °C will relieve residual stresses and enhance interparticle diffusion.
A controlled atmosphere during cold spraying prevents oxidation.
Inert-atmosphere annealing prevents contamination.
Annealing for a suitable duration enables interparticle recrystallization and microstructural homogenization without melting.
Post-deposition annealing promotes crystallographic homogenization and reduces residual stresses.
The proposed process will create a robust interface between the repair overlay and the base material.
Cold spray is a solid-state process that avoids formation of a liquid phase.
Avoiding a liquid phase eliminates the associated hot-cracking risk.
The kinetic energy of high-velocity particles creates a high-quality mechanical interlock with the substrate.
Low-temperature annealing facilitates interparticle diffusion and recrystallization, thereby restoring ductility and mitigating residual stresses.
Fusion welding melts material and can produce a fusion zone and partial-melting region in a high-entropy-alloy joint.
Fusion welding can substantially alter the weld microstructure relative to the high-entropy-alloy base material.
Low-melting-point phases formed or present during fusion welding initiate hot cracking and degrade joint performance.
The cold-spray repair will match or exceed the strength and toughness of traditional fusion-weld repairs while showing no hot cracking.
The repaired overlay will provide enhanced performance under cyclic loading, high stress, and other aggressive operating conditions.
